decisions.reason: Schlager CD has a loyal niche audience and low keeping cost, so the option remains open while uncertainty persists.
Illustrated series may still build collector value and keeping existing releases is inexpensive, so the option is retained.
Reissued jazz vinyl benefits from the vinyl revival and has low ongoing cost, making the option valuable to keep.
Multi-disc box set ties up storage and inventory capital and its niche demand is uncertain, so the option is no longer worth holding.
A generic compilation CD faces declining CD demand and has had limited promotion, indicating its value is unlikely to be realized.
